content_blocks.heading: Complete Makeup Toolkit on Amazon India
content_blocks.dek: A step-by-step makeup toolkit organized by routine categories—from cleanser and SPF to foundation, lips, mascara, and tools—with curated Amazon.in picks.

_original.name: Prep & Base Routine
_original.why: Start with cleanser, moisturizer, SPF, primer, foundation, concealer, and powder for a solid base.
_original.skipIf: You already have your base routine sorted.

_original.name: Eyes, Lips & Glow
_original.why: Build your look with blush, highlighter, brows, eyeshadow, liner, mascara, and lip picks.
_original.skipIf: You only need one specific refill.

_original.name: Lock In & Tools
_original.why: Finish with setting spray and tools that make application easier and longer lasting.
_original.skipIf: You already own setting and tool essentials.

faqs.question: How is the makeup toolkit organized?
faqs.answer: Products are organized by routine steps—from cleanser and moisturizer to mascara and tools—so you can build a complete kit in order.

faqs.question: Are prices and discounts live?
faqs.answer: Prices, MRP, and discount labels shown on Durza are indicative and may change. Always check the latest price, offer, and availability on Amazon.in before buying.

faqs.question: Do all products have images and verified links?
faqs.answer: Existing verified picks keep their images and affiliate links. New slots being added may use placeholders until verified product images and links are provided.
